title: PairRecover
description: Canonical request to complete authenticated token recovery using receiver-issued challenge.

michi_id.description: Identity derived as base64url(BLAKE3(public_key)), exactly 43 chars, no padding

public_key.description: Ed25519 public key in base64url, exactly 43 chars, no padding

challenge_nonce.description: Receiver-issued nonce in base64url (at least 16 bytes, 22 chars)

challenge_signature.description: Ed25519 signature of the challenge_nonce in base64url, exactly 86 chars, no padding
